one_liner: Nonappropriated-fund (NAF) contract specialist for Stars and Stripes in DC, running procurements from solicitation through award and administration, and possibly serving as contracting officer.
fit_summary: This procurement job names three years of government contracting and NAF contracting experience as what makes a candidate best qualified. Daniel's proposal and purchasing work at IEM was contractor-side, and NAF priority groups are considered first, so it's a long shot.
eligibility: Open to the public (NAF hiring path); no federal status is required, and no clearance is required.
NAF priority categories (business-based actions, current or former NAF/APF employees, veterans and spouses) are considered first, and his resume shows none of these.
"Highly Preferred" or "Best Qualified" screens: 3 years of government contracting experience and any NAF contracting experience.
Resume must be two pages or less and should include full contact information for professional and personal references.
strategy: Skip this one: the best-qualified screen is three years of government contracting, and his proposal and purchasing work at IEM was contractor-side.
GS-9 or trainee 1102 postings open to the public are a better start for a procurement career.
resume_bullets: Led proposal writing in answer to government solicitations found in SAM.gov, GovWin and BidPro (2019–2024).
Procured supplies and set up relationships with medical supply and truck rental vendors for COVID-19 sites (2021–2022).
interview_questions: Walk us through a procurement you handled from requirement to award.
How do you evaluate offers and decide which is most advantageous?
How would you develop an SOP for a small NAF contracting office?
Describe a contract negotiation or dispute and how you resolved it.
watch_outs: The posting prefers three years of contracting plus NAF experience, and his resume shows neither.
NAF priority groups are considered before outside non-veteran applicants.
There is no telework and no promotion potential, the commute from Manassas to DC is daily, and incentives will not be paid.
